configurePresets.name: windows-base
configurePresets.description: Run from a VS Developer PowerShell so clang-cl, llvm-rc, lld-link and ninja are on PATH. CMAKE_RC_COMPILER is llvm-rc: the Windows SDK rc.exe is the only tool in this chain that is not long-path aware and fails with RC1109 under a deep build path. llvm-rc has no such limit, and this repo has no .rc files of its own, so it only ever compiles the manifest CMake generates. It ships with the same VS 'C++ Clang tools for Windows' component clang-cl comes from.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl
configurePresets.description: The shipping configuration, and the only Windows toolchain.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl-debug
configurePresets.description: Engine changes should be checked here as well as in Release: Release passes some out-of-bounds reads silently.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl-coverage
configurePresets.description: Instruments the test binary for LLVM source-based coverage. Driven by Scripts/Get-Coverage.ps1; never measure speed or strength with it.
